sloka: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वा ऋषयो ब्रह्मवादिनः ।दृष्ट्वा तत्तुमुलं युद्धं परं विस्मयमागमन् ।। ७.१५.६ ॥
transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ ।dṛṣṭvā tattumulaṁ yuddhaṁ paraṁ vismayamāgaman ।। 7.15.6 ॥

translations.english: Then, the gods along with the Gandharvas, and the sages who expound the Vedas, having witnessed that tumultuous battle, were filled with great wonder.
